description:
Reproducible experiment and analysis software for a preregistered audit of TabPFN v2, TabICL v2, XGBoost, LightGBM, and Random Forest under five wrong-but-present feature-value corruptions.

New in version 1.1.0: the preregistered cleaning ablation. This adds the tfm_dirty_values_ablation package, the frozen ablation configuration, its preregistration and validation report, the 2,425-task manifest, the paired-identity probe report, the frozen ablation analysis, and the completion and result-verification records. The ablation tests one fixed off-the-shelf cleaner, Tukey-fence winsorization of numeric columns plus consolidation of unseen categorical levels, fitted only on the corrupted context partition and applied to both the context and query partitions. The result is a bounded negative one: no corruption mechanism showed a corrected positive recovery of ROC-AUC, and applying the same cleaner to already-clean input reduced ROC-AUC on every estimator tested. The version 1.0.0 degradation panel is unchanged, and no file inside the frozen tfm_dirty_values package was modified, so the earlier authorization identity remains valid.
title: Beyond Missingness: Reproducibility Software for a Dirty Feature Value Audit
